### A new way to move around, and the new logo

**The floating menu.** The top bar is gone. A round button now hovers over the page and opens the navigation, so your screen keeps its full height.

**Bigger, easier targets.** The navigation is a full-size list now — taller rows, larger icons and text — so a page can be opened with one thumb without aiming.

**Elbiko writes its name once.** Inside the app you now see just the wordmark, at the top of the sidebar, the way ChatGPT titles its own sidebar. The logo itself lives on your home screen.

**The new logo** — the ring, the arrow, the check and the hourglass — is now the app icon.

**Everything from the dashboard.** The quick links at the bottom of the Dashboard used to be five sections; now every section is there, in navigation order, with Focus kept as the main button.
